_comment: Listening practice «شنیدن عددها»: prices, times, dates, phone numbers and other numbers the way people really say them. 'say' is the spoken sentence, with the numbers written as words so the voice reads them reliably; 'show' is the right answer as it appears on the button (digits, left to right); 'alts' are wrong answers that sound similar (fifteen / fifty, 4.99 / 9.49); 'fa' is the Farsi meaning shown after the answer. Phone numbers are practice numbers only (555-01xx). kind: price | time | date | phone | number.
